thirtySeconds: KeithK75 won the net race at Shinnecock Hills by eight shots, posting +1 while HamSammich finished second at +9. MashedBROtato was third at +15, with Dan94 and DREADFUL both at +27. The raw-golf scoreboard backed up the result: Keith also won gross at -3, gaining 17.79 strokes overall, including 8.05 on approach and 6.68 around the green. Dan94 was the gross runner-up at +19, while the rest of the field wandered deep into the numbers.
latestTournamentTeaser: KeithK75 ran away with the net title at Shinnecock Hills, winning by eight and taking gross honors at -3. Behind him, Dan94's +19 gross was solid enough for second, while HamSammich somehow turned +37 gross into the net runner-up spot.

carnage.name: Dan94
carnage.commentary: A 229-yard opener into deep rough started the mess, and the recovery tour got worse from there: 127 yards to fairway, 170 more to fairway, then repeated attempts to escape from seven yards out. After finally reaching the green from 27 yards, he left a 19-footer one foot short and tapped in for a nine. That is not a hole; that is a small infrastructure project.

carnage.name: IUDoc92
carnage.commentary: The first shot found deep rough, the second found sand, and then the next three somehow kept finding fairway from 42, 42, and 41 yards out. A 30-yard pitch finally reached the green, followed by a 25-footer left one foot short. Eight strokes later, the ball was legally in the hole and everyone could go home.

carnage.name: DREADFUL
carnage.commentary: A 119-yard shot into deep rough on a par three was only the opening act. The next four shots bounced between fairway, deep rough, and green-side territory before a 12-footer was left one foot short. Seven strokes for a par three, with four separate attempts just to become vaguely golf-adjacent.

carnage.name: Leroy4522
carnage.commentary: The drive went 213 yards into deep rough, then the approach wandered to fairway and another fairway before a 12-yard pitch left 32 feet. Three putts later, including a 41-footer and a 20-footer, the ball finally reached tap-in range. Eight strokes, seven of them apparently committed to making the green feel unwelcome.

carnage.name: HamSammich
carnage.commentary: The opening three shots went deep rough, deep rough, deep rough, shrinking the hole from 234 yards to 46 without ever locating a useful surface. Two more recovery shots reached eight yards, then a six-yard chip got to six feet. The tap-in seven was technically a finish, but the route there looked like a search party.

carnage.name: KeithK75
carnage.commentary: The drive found fairway and the next shot reached the green, so naturally the third went 165 yards into deep rough. The shot log then jumps from three to five, with the next recorded effort still 158 yards from deep rough, before a 23-yard pitch and an 11-footer cleaned up the seven. Even the winner had one hole where the simulator tried to file a missing-person report.

carnage.name: MashedBROtato
carnage.commentary: A 130-yard shot found rough, the next went 38 yards to fairway, and a third finally reached the green from 21 yards. From there came a 17-footer left two feet short and the mandatory tap-in. Five on a par three is not catastrophic by this field's standards, but it was still a full-length scenic route.

players.name: KeithK75
players.tagline: Approach shots so good they made the fairway optional
players.body: KeithK75 took both competitions at Shinnecock Hills, winning net at +1 and gross at -3. The eight-shot net gap over HamSammich was backed by the best raw performance in the field: 17.79 total strokes gained, with 15.35 tee to green, 8.05 on approach, and 6.68 in the short game. He hit 10 greens, made four birdies, avoided every bogey, and needed only 24 putts. The ugly spot was the seven, where a fairway start turned into deep rough, a 19-yard recovery, and an 11-foot make after the shot log skips from three to five. Even that looked like a speed bump. With seven prior starts, four gross wins and two net wins, this was another strong confirmation that Keith's raw golf is the class of the group.

players.name: HamSammich
players.tagline: A long hitter conducting a four-round search for a green
players.body: HamSammich finished second in net at +9 despite a +37 gross card, eight shots behind Keith and 18 clear of MashedBROtato. The scoreboard owes plenty to the net result, because the raw golf was barely positive at 0.79 strokes gained: 0.66 off the tee and 2.37 putting, dragged down by -2.06 approach and -1.58 tee to green. Four greens in regulation, seven bogeys, four doubles, and 29 putts tell the story. His worst hole was a seven after three straight deep-rough visits, followed by two more recovery shots before a six-yard pitch. Still, the net runner-up finish fits a five-start profile that has produced plenty of net contention despite -2.19 average total SG and no wins.

players.name: MashedBROtato
players.tagline: Bombs it 305 and then asks the short game to explain itself
players.body: MashedBROtato took third in net at +15 and fourth gross at +39, with a respectable 4.79 total strokes gained that could not survive eight bogeys and two doubles. The raw strengths were approach at 3.07 and tee to green at 4.77, helped by a 317-yard longest drive, but only three fairways and six greens made the course a recurring recovery exercise. The putting number was essentially neutral at 0.02, and the five on the par three came through rough, fairway, green, and a two-foot miss before the tap-in. He did flash better golf with three birdies, including a 25-foot make and a net two, but seven prior starts show a volatile profile: one net win, one gross win, and average SG almost exactly neutral at -0.06.

players.name: Dan94
players.tagline: The fairways were fine; the scorecard was not
players.body: Dan94 was fourth in net at +27 but second in gross at +19, the clearest example of the net and gross boards telling different stories. His 6.79 total strokes gained was second-best among the challengers, powered by 3.63 approach, 1.47 short game, and 5.71 tee to green. He hit eight fairways and seven greens, but eight bogeys erased the cleaner ball-striking. The nine came after a 229-yard drive into deep rough, three more awkward recovery shots, and a 27-yard pitch before a 19-footer was left one foot short. Across seven prior starts, Dan94 owns two gross wins and a strong 11.97 average total SG, so the raw result was no fluke; the net number just refused to cooperate.

players.name: DREADFUL
players.tagline: The name got a full statistical audit
players.body: DREADFUL finished fifth in net at +27 and sixth gross at +75 after losing 12.21 strokes overall. The damage was everywhere: -6.09 off the tee, -1.34 approach, -0.44 short game, and -4.34 putting, with only three greens, 35 putts, three three-putts, four bogeys, and eight doubles. The seven began with a 119-yard shot into deep rough and continued through four more scrambling attempts before a 12-footer was left one foot short. That hole was a neat summary of the day, but the broader result also matches a seven-start profile averaging -6.33 total SG, 5.71 greens, and 4.14 doubles per appearance. There were a couple of net birdie moments, but not enough to stop the wheels coming off.

players.name: IUDoc92
players.tagline: One holed-out eagle-shaped miracle against a lot of rough
players.body: IUDoc92 finished sixth in net at +32 and fifth gross at +72, gaining -10.21 strokes overall. The breakdown was rough: -3.49 tee, -0.45 approach, -3.90 short game, and -2.36 putting, with just two greens in regulation and 34 putts. The worst hole required eight shots after the opening ball found deep rough, the next found sand, and three more attempts failed to produce a clean route before a 30-yard pitch. There was one undeniable highlight: an 18-yard hole-out for a net three, plus a made nine-footer elsewhere. But seven prior starts have produced -9.32 average total SG, 4.29 greens, and 3.57 doubles per appearance, so the flashes remain buried under too much damage.

players.name: Leroy4522
players.tagline: The putting stats are doing all the heavy lifting
players.body: Leroy4522 finished seventh in both net and gross, at +28 and +55 respectively, losing 11.21 strokes overall. Only one green in regulation set the tone, while -3.55 off the tee, -2.04 approach, and -4.05 short game left the putting to mop up a nine-foot average proximity number and 36 total putts. The eight came after a deep-rough drive, two fairway detours, a 32-foot leave, and three straight putts from 41, 20, and 14 feet. He did post a net three and a level four on the back side, but seven prior starts show the same broad struggle: -5.74 average total SG, -4.36 approach, and an average net finish of 6.86. The occasional rescue is real; the sustained escape route is not.

stateOfLeague: KeithK75 did more than win the net title: he also owned the gross board and posted the field's best raw performance by a mile. The event strengthens his seven-start profile as the league's most reliable all-around ball-striker, while Dan94's second-place gross finish and HamSammich's net runner-up spot underline the league's central tension: solid raw golf and useful net golf are not always the same thing.
